review: 702.54c: skip reason was false (Bloodlord of Vaasgoth grants a second bloodthirst instance to a Vampire spell); replaced the skip with scenario 702.54c-1.

scenarios.title: Bloodthirst N gives N counters if an opponent was dealt damage this turn

setup.notes: Gorehorn Minotaurs is a 3/3 with bloodthirst 2.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping a Mountain. Both players pass; Shock resolves.
A casts Gorehorn Minotaurs, tapping four Mountains. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: opponent_damaged
variants.expected: B is at 18. Gorehorn Minotaurs enters with two +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5.

variants.label: creature_damaged
variants.delta: Shock targets Grizzly Bears instead of player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears dies, B stays at 20, and Gorehorn Minotaurs enters with no counters as a 3/3.

variants.label: self_damaged
variants.delta: Shock targets player A instead of player B.
variants.expected: A is at 18, B stays at 20, and Gorehorn Minotaurs enters with no counters as a 3/3.

setup.notes: Petrified Wood-Kin is a 3/3 with bloodthirst X that costs {6}{G}.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping the Mountain. Both players pass; Shock resolves.
A casts Petrified Wood-Kin, tapping seven Forests. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: shock_to_face
variants.expected: B is at 18. Petrified Wood-Kin enters with two +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5.

variants.label: bolt_to_face
variants.delta: A holds Lightning Bolt instead of Shock and casts it at player B.

scenarios.title: Two bloodthirst instances each add their counters

setup.notes: Bloodlord of Vaasgoth: whenever A casts a Vampire creature spell, it gains bloodthirst 3. Bloodrage Vampire is a 3/1 Vampire with bloodthirst 1 costing {2}{B}.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping the Mountain. Both players pass; Shock resolves.
A casts Bloodrage Vampire, tapping three Swamps. Bloodlord of Vaasgoth's trigger goes on the stack above it; both players pass and the trigger resolves.
Both players pass; Bloodrage Vampire resolves.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: B is at 18. Bloodrage Vampire enters with four +1/+1 counters (1 from its own bloodthirst 1, 3 from the granted bloodthirst 3) and is a 7/5.

variants.label: no_bloodlord
variants.delta: Bloodlord of Vaasgoth is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: B is at 18. Bloodrage Vampire enters with one +1/+1 counter and is a 4/2.

variants.label: opponent_not_damaged
variants.delta: Shock targets player A instead of player B.
variants.expected: A is at 18, B stays at 20. Bloodrage Vampire enters with no counters as a 3/1.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge grants the keyword through Animate on TriggeredCardLKICopy with Duration Permanent; check that the granted bloodthirst reaches the spell and applies as it enters.
